correctness.rationale: For each fixed coprime n>=4,k, the prescribed q=e^{-a/(2n)} return is expanded uniformly in C1 on a compact phase-detuning rectangle. The unique closest positive and negative sites give the two non-negligible q tails. The negative site is visited at the arithmetic time t_*k≡-1 mod n. Their q^2 tails and translation drift yield H_a=σ−2sinh(u)+q[2sinh(2u)−a(1+(t_*σ/n)e^u)]+O(a²q²). Strict negative u-derivative gives existence and uniqueness, implicit expansion gives B0 and finite itinerary propagation gives every Bj. Exact multiplier identity Λ−1=aq∂uH and implicit b differentiation give the remaining formulas. Analytic estimates apply to infinitely large a; the 40 high-precision cases only check consistency. Scope excludes growing denominators and nonlocal cycles.

value.rationale: The new n>=4 formula quantifies a naturally motivated hopping sensitivity of rational rotation-like population/game-theory maps at the critical exponential detuning scale. The leading universal arsinh profile erases the numerator, but the precise first exponentially small spatial response B_j restores arithmetic information via the inverse k^{-1} mod n. This fully resolves the first fine-structure correction for all finite rational classes instead of making an arbitrary numerical cut or merely reproducing the n=3 case. The formula supports comparisons of which cyclic phase visits the critical negative gate first and how that affects observed orbit coordinates.
